name: api.agi.tech
description:
An MCP that can use your entire phone. It can use every app, without any integrations or connectors. It gives your agent access to tap and type on your screen, just like you do. No integrations to build, and nothing to configure per app. 
Android now live, iOS coming soon. 

Use cases: 
- Connect your phone to your agent OpenClaw, Hermes, Eve, Cursor, Claude Code, etc 
- Developer testing: test your Android app under real-world conditions on a variety of screen sizes
- Automations: do recurring task on phones

_published_faq.name: How do I add api.agi.tech to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add api.agi.tech to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.agi.tech/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the api.agi.tech MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: api.agi.tech lists 15 MCP tools, including list_devices, phone_device_pause, phone_device_resume, phone_device_status, phone_get_state, phone_run_task, phone_session_end, phone_session_start, phone_task_cancel, phone_task_message, phone_task_monitor, and phone_task_pause.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to api.agi.tech?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to api.agi.tech in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
api.agi.tech requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
api.agi.tech is developed by AGI, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
